question: Which book by Sophie Elmhirst was honoured with the Nero Book of the Year award in 2025?

options.text: The Girl with the Seven Lives

solution:
The correct answer is __**Maurice and Maralyn**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sophie Elmhirst** is a renowned author known for her compelling storytelling and in-depth exploration of human emotions and relationships.
 
• The book **Maurice and Maralyn**, written by Sophie Elmhirst, was recognized with the prestigious **Nero Book of the Year award in 2025**, a significant accolade in the literary world.
 
• The **Nero Book of the Year award** is given annually to outstanding works of fiction that demonstrate literary excellence and innovation.
